verdict.rationale: A first-party GitHub repository exists (github.com/wezterm/wezterm), and community comments mention GitHub issues and sponsoring the author there, which implies the source is publicly readable. Nothing in the pack names the license or confirms it is an open-source license, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license identification, documentation confirming the full source is published, independent corroboration of licensing terms.
